title: Consumer-Time Validity in Stateful AI Runtimes: Verifying Recovered State and Deferred Authority
abstract: arXiv:2611.29004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stateful LLM serving engines and agent runtimes reuse execution state and deferred permissions across components and sessions. A cancellation, rollback, or approval is recorded by one component and relied on by another, and recording it does not make the later use valid: a downstream consumer may read state or dispatch an action whose identity, production status, allocation, or target revision has since changed. We call the missing check consumer-time validity and separate two forms. State validity governs what a consumer reads. On vLLM with LMCache, an interrupted KV load leaves unwritten blocks indexed, and a host-only counter rewind desynchronizes the GPU position, so a second tenant generates a schema-valid tool call naming the wrong tenant in 10/10 native-fault runs; the call is recorded and not executed. Authority freshness governs what a consumer executes: on a multi-session approval runtime, an unrevoked deferred grant overwrot

translated_title: 有状态AI运行时中的消费者时有效性：验证恢复状态与延迟授权
translated_abstract: 有状态的LLM服务引擎和智能体运行时会在组件与会话之间复用执行状态和延迟权限。取消、回滚或批准由一个组件记录，而被另一个组件依赖，但记录本身并不能保证后续使用的有效性：下游消费者可能读取状态或调度一个其身份、生产状态、分配或目标修订版本此后已发生变化的动作。我们将这种缺失的检查称为“消费者时有效性”，并将其区分为两种形式。状态有效性约束消费者所读取的内容：在配备LMCache的vLLM上，被中断的KV缓存加载会留下已索引但未写入的块，而仅在主机端进行的计数器回退会导致GPU位置失去同步，因此在10/10次原生故障运行中，第二个租户生成了模式合法但指向错误租户的工具调用；该调用被记录但未被执行。权限新鲜度约束消费者所执行的内容：在多会话批准运行时上，一个未被撤销的延迟授权覆盖……
tldr: 该论文提出“消费者时有效性”这一新概念，指出在有状态AI运行时中，一个组件记录的取消、回滚或批准并不能保证下游消费时的有效性，并将其分为约束读取内容的状态有效性与约束执行内容的权限新鲜度两类缺失检查。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "consumer-time validity" in stateful AI runtimes, showing that a cancellation, rollback, or approval recorded by one component does not guarantee validity when relied upon downstream, and separates this missing check into state validity (governing what is read) and authority freshness (governing what is executed).
